notes: Version 1.7 aligns the description of Q6a with Q6a 2.3: Q6a defines gauge charges as fibre invariants and reads the connection as the generator of fibre transport under two continuum hypotheses it does not prove, with the Yang-Mills action as a structural motivation; it does not derive the Yang-Mills principle. SU(3) is described as a hypothesis whose identification is open. The results of Q12 are unchanged.
